_about: Registry of speech datasets considered for LingoSync. Every figure is copied from the dataset's own page (checked 2026-11-19); 'not stated' means the page did not say. Do not add figures that were not verified.

used.name: mesolitica/Malaysian-Emilia-v2 (malaysian_podcast subset)
used.size: Whole dataset 1.56M segments; malaysian_podcast metadata has 356,815 segments (~989 h, counted locally from the metadata parquet)
used.format: MP3 segments in zip archives + parquet metadata (text, start, end, speaker, language, dnsmos)
used.transcripts: Yes. How they were produced is not stated; Emilia-style pipelines normally use automatic ASR, so treat them as possibly machine-generated
used.speaker_ids: Per-episode diarisation labels (SPEAKER_00, ...); not global, so splits are made by episode
used.code_mixed: Yes in practice: Malaysian podcast speech with English inside Malay (e.g. 'So, kita pun terpaksa evolve ikut cara PKP'). Not labelled as code-mixed by the publisher
used.role: Training and validation only (labels may be machine-made, so not used as a test set)

used.name: IISc-MILE Tamil ASR Corpus (OpenSLR SLR127)
used.format: 16 kHz 16-bit mono PCM WAV + UTF-8 .txt transcripts, train/test folders
used.speaker_ids: Not stated on the page; derived from file names if present
used.role: Training data for Tamil acoustics; transcripts romanised for the romanised-Tamil target

used.name: Crowdsourced high-quality Tamil multi-speaker speech data set (OpenSLR SLR65)
used.size: ta_in_female.zip 769 MB + ta_in_male.zip 603 MB; hours not stated
used.speaker_ids: Anonymised file IDs; speaker ID not stated

approved_needs_user_account.name: Malay Conversational Speech Corpus (MagicHub; SEACrowd loader asr_malcsc)
approved_needs_user_account.licence: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 (no redistribution of modified copies)
approved_needs_user_account.access: MagicHub download; account requirement to be confirmed by the user

approved_needs_user_account.name: AI4Bharat IndicVoices (Tamil subset)
approved_needs_user_account.access: Gated: Hugging Face login and accepting the conditions
approved_needs_user_account.size: 11.2K transcribed hours across 22 languages; Tamil hours not stated
approved_needs_user_account.transcripts: Yes; whether English words / code-mixing are marked is not stated
approved_needs_user_account.role: Spontaneous Tamil training data, if the user creates an account

approved_needs_user_account.name: Mozilla Common Voice (Malay, Tamil) via Mozilla Data Collective
approved_needs_user_account.licence: Not verified (dataset pages render client-side and could not be read)
approved_needs_user_account.size: Search listings: Malay Scripted 24.0 2,092 clips / 3.57 h; Malay Spontaneous 3.0 1,150 clips / 6.19 h / 24 speakers. Tamil not verified

excluded.name: mesolitica/Malaysian-STT-Whisper
excluded.reason: No licence stated; transcripts are Whisper large-v3 pseudo-labels

excluded.name: mesolitica/malaya-speech-malay-stt
excluded.reason: No licence stated; partly Google STT semi-supervised labels

excluded.name: MUCS 2021 (OpenSLR SLR103/SLR104)
excluded.reason: Code-switched pairs are Hindi-English and Bengali-English only; SLR103 has no Tamil

excluded.name: BabelSpeech 50 h Malay colloquial
excluded.reason: No source found that shows this dataset exists

excluded.name: Zhagaram Labs Tamil/Tanglish conversational corpus
excluded.reason: No source found that shows this dataset exists

known_gap: No publicly downloadable, verifiable Tamil-English code-mixed speech corpus was found. Tamil-English test data must come from consented, hand-transcribed recordings made with the app.
